csv_project_name: CM for CDBG-DR Oregon & Gray Road
csv_scope_of_work: Spokane County is seeking a professional program/construction management firm, experienced in Disaster Recovery activities, to provide a broad range of services under the Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) fund provided by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). This vendor will oversee housing reconstruction and rehabilitation project implementation including but not limited to, outreach, case management, eligibility determination, construction oversight and compliance, activity closeout, and ongoing monitoring. The particular housing activities may include but are not limited to, permitting, architectural designs, procurement of materials/labor, remediation, site work, inspections, compliance, home purchase assistance, and other cross-cutting requirements as necessary
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services
